name: autoscirub
description: AutoSciRub skills for inducing executable scientific rubrics and guiding criterion-level research revision.

interface.longDescription: AutoSciRub turns underspecified scientific research instructions into task-specific executable rubrics, then verifies reports criterion by criterion and supports targeted revision rounds.
defaultPrompt: Use AutoSciRub to induce an executable rubric for this research task.
Verify this report against the AutoSciRub rubric.
Run one targeted AutoSciRub revision round.
